newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee off highs, cocoa pares losses.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee off highs, cocoa pares losses.

text.p: COFFEE - Ends off session peaks after profit-taking, despite renewed strength in NY. May up $43 at $1,643.
COCOA - Down on bearish technicals, sterling strength, but ends off day's lows. May down 13 at 869.
SUGAR - Firms accross board. March/May widens in solid pre-expiry trade. March up $1.30 at $304.90 at 1705 GMT.
